function buildChannel(s, mask): HTMLCanvasElement;

Defined in: website/components/home/about/glitch/fx.ts:104

Renders a channel-isolated copy of the portrait: the image is drawn cover-fit, then a pure-channel ink is multiplied over it so only that RGB channel survives. Two offsets of these under 'lighter' produce a true chromatic split.

s

GlitchSession

The session the channel copy is sized/drawn from.
